description: An item's stock movement history at one warehouse, newest first — the Inventory page's movement log: receipts, sales, adjustments, moves, transfers and (with includeReservations) reservations, each with the document, location, quantity, cost, who did it and the running available total. Use it to explain why stock changed.

clientId.description: Optional client id (GUID) for operator (unpinned) credentials on 3PL tenants.

includeReservations.description: Include reservation and release events (default false).

upc.description: Item UPC/barcode, used when SKU is absent or unmatched.

warehouseId.description: Warehouse id (GUID). May be omitted when the tenant has exactly one Internal warehouse.

name: get_stock_movements
title: Stock Movements
